resources.string: Enable “Allow from this source” for JeekMusic in Android settings. The downloaded update will resume when you return. Android may still require confirmation under its install policy.
Waiting for Android to finish. JeekMusic will close when the update is applied.
Android requested a system confirmation for this update. Continue to review it, or close to cancel. Update diagnostics record this result; the update has not completed yet.
The APK signing identity does not match this installation. Download a release from the same distributor.
The downloaded APK does not match the expected package, version or checksum. Please check for updates again.
The previous update was interrupted. Retry to continue with the downloaded APK.
Android did not complete the update. Check free space and installation settings, then retry. You can copy update diagnostics from About & updates.
Copy Android version, installation source, permissions and the last install session result. No download addresses, credentials or music data are included.
